sip.title: Smart Image Protection
sip.entryBody: You can now manage non-compliant images with Smart Image Protection.
sip.intro: We go through every picture on this location and pick out the ones that don’t belong — selfies, screenshots, forwarded files and anything that isn’t your store — then flag them to Google for removal.
sip.methodBody: Every image is matched against the same rules that block a bad upload — including names that point to a competitor or to something that isn't your store — and for the pictures we hold we measure the real size and sharpness: under {{min}}px on a side, or no detail at all, gets flagged. It reads names and pixels, not the picture itself, so it can't see a competitor's board or a stranger's face in a neutrally-named photo. Those still need your eye.
sip.reasonSmall: Only {{w}}×{{h}} pixels — Google needs at least {{min}} on each side.
sip.reasonSoft: Almost no detail in this picture — it reads as out of focus. Retake it in good light.
sip.coverNote: This is your cover — it can’t be removed, only replaced.
sip.nameOnlyNote_one: {{count}} of them was checked by name only — we don’t hold that picture, so there was nothing to measure.
